messages:
ana: Quick sync — customer ask from Acme: they want a concrete Optimize playbook for batching/caching + eval regressions before next Dedicated release. Asking product for scoping + launch criteria.

matt: +1. Need to tie to OKR: reduce token cost by 20% and 99th pctl latency SLO. What counts as MVP here?

liam: From infra side, MVP = offline analyzer that outputs per-route batching + KV cache suggestion + a small perf report. Must include data sample size (>=100k reqs) and synthetic replay.

ana: @liam small correction — analyzer should support both prefix and KV cache suggestions, and flag cases where caching changes semantics (e.g., user-specific prompts).

ana: also: requirement: regression detection must run daily on a canonical prompt set and alert on >2% quality drop or >10% latency increase.

matt: For launch gating, propose: (1) automated analyzer + suggestions in console, (2) alerting on regressions integrated with rollouts, (3) 3 customer pilots onboarded, (4) docs + runbook. Agree? :thinking_face:

liam: sounds reasonable. We should define the canonical prompt set format — minimal fields: id, prompt, expected_embedding_similarity OR pass/fail check. Example snippet: ```json
{"id":"greet-001","prompt":"Summarize user message","check":"contains:summary"}```

ana: Ops constraints: suggestions must include estimated token-savings and risk level (low/med/high). Low-risk -> auto-recommend, high-risk -> manual review.

sophia: UX ask: Console should show before/after estimates plus a one-click apply for safe recommendations. Also include roll-forward button to revert if regression triggered.

matt: Prioritization: Core team capacity this quarter is limited. Proposed split: 6 weeks for analyzer + backend, 3 weeks for console integration, 3 weeks for eval/regression infra and docs. Pilot onboarding runs in parallel.

liam: Telemetry: need sample rates and retention for diffing. Suggest retention 30 days for eval traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics.

ana: Customer requirement: encryption in flight + KMS support for prompt sets and stored traces for Private deployments. Mark as non-negotiable for Private beta.

matt: Ok — action items: 1) liam build analyzer prototype (due in 2 weeks), 2) sophia mock console cards (1 week), 3) ana collect 3 pilot customers and consent for prompt sets (1 week), 4) docs owner TBD. I'll allocate runway from Optimize backlog.

ops-bot: CI job queued: optimize-analyzer/proto-tests #451 started by liam.

ana: One more thing — launch criterion: regression false-positive rate < 5% on validation set. Otherwise delay rollouts.

matt: Good call. We'll add that to the gating checklist. Meeting next Tue to confirm MVP scope and timeline. :calendar:
